question: Are the new token-aligned P and C control pairs natively answer-capable on both sides, so their later patch responses can measure collateral rather than model uncertainty?

frozen_design.population: Exactly the 16 P and 16 C rows from the aligned-control authority; A1/A2 target logits and every causal arm remain unopened.

panels.P: Same-tense answer-preserving Today/Yesterday to Currently/Previously cue pairing, reported independently.
panels.C: Unrelated same-answer nighttime completion with equal-length rotated place/role lexicon, reported independently.

capability_threshold.cell_rule: Each P/base, P/donor, C/base, and C/donor accuracy is at least 0.875.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_and_exact_pop: All hashes match, all 32 rows satisfy the full-sequence alignment contract, panel counts are 16/16, and the derived 0.875 population contract is exactly 14/16 for each panel.
predictions.pred_b_each_panel_side_cell_capable: Each of the four panel/side cells reaches native answer-over-foil accuracy at least 0.875.
predictions.pred_c_each_panel_joint_population_capab: At least 14/16 rows in P and independently at least 14/16 rows in C are correct on both base and donor sides.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_access_and_exact_price: Exactly two native forwards and 64 example-side evaluations occur, with no interventions, backwards, updates, or A1/A2 outcome access.

decision: If all predictions pass, publish a capability manifest and replay the already-frozen five-piece 32-mask attention lattice with P and C selectivity reported separately. If authority or price fails, mark invalid. Otherwise preserve a capability null and repair or replace only the failing control panel before causal replay.
